items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: I was by the name of Louis Smoot. And, they had told him, Bornhagen had lots of work.

ctx.x: Did you get paid for that or just help?

Oh, yeah, he paid me. He gave me two dollars then. Oh, yeah. Yeah. He gave me two dollars. I don't think about no pay. I don't think about no pay, man. What a week. So, that evening when he finished, I'm coming home with him from work. It felt big. So, I came home. Mama said, well, you do all right? I said, yeah. He said, yeah. But it could. He said, but he's too small. I don't want to do that. I said, but he's going to school. Mama said, well, I'll tell you, Sam. I said, while he wants to, I'd like him to learn…
You actually, you did more than just carrying the stuff.
